description: Copy a published gallery workflow into the API key's workspace as a private workflow. Free. Each call makes another copy. You do not need a copy just to run a public workflow; clone it to keep it or to edit it. A copy of a protected workflow keeps its steps hidden: you can run it and change its title, description and tags, but not its steps.

slug.description: The full slug or page URL of a published workflow from list_workflows scope "public".

name: clone_workflow
title: Clone a public Wiro workflow
